hooks.name: aircraft-log-session-start
hooks.description: Record that a Kiro chat session started (aircraft_mcp session log).

hooks.name: aircraft-log-prompt
hooks.description: Record each prompt the user submits (read from USER_PROMPT).

hooks.name: aircraft-log-tool-call
hooks.description: Record each aircraft-gateway tool call before it runs: tool name and full input.

hooks.name: aircraft-log-tool-result
hooks.description: Record each aircraft-gateway tool call after it runs, with the result Kiro passes.

hooks.name: aircraft-log-agent-stop
hooks.description: Record that the agent finished its turn.
